plugins.name: Magic Touch Photo
plugins.description: Draw a green Keep+ lasso to preserve its selected area, or a red Keep- lasso to remove its selected area.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.attribution: MediaPipe Tasks Vision and MagicTouch model by Google

plugins.release_notes: Adds true lasso-based Keep+ and Keep- selection. Keep+ preserves the selected area; Keep- removes the selected area while preserving the rest. Retains compatibility with legacy positive/negative brush clients.

plugins.description: Translate text on this device with automatic language detection and on-demand offline language models. Requires Link speech-to-text and Persian text-to-speech plugins for voice input and read-aloud.

license.attribution: Google ML Kit Translation and Language Identification APIs
license.name: Apache-2.0

plugins.name: Offline Smart Translate
plugins.release_notes: Adds automatic installation of Link speech-to-text and Persian text-to-speech dependencies. Translation models remain downloaded on demand and are not bundled in the plugin.
